scenario: A super administrator's password and one-time code are phished; no security key or passkey is enforced, and the same account is used for daily mail
affected_assets: Admin console, every user's mail and files, domain and DNS settings, audit logs
treatment: Move privileged work to dedicated admin accounts, enforce security-key or passkey 2SV for administrators after a tested recovery route, and route admin sign-in alerts to a reachable owner

scenario: The only super administrator loses their security key or leaves the firm; nobody else can recover the tenant
threat_source: Single point of failure in administration
affected_assets: Admin console access, tenant recovery, every downstream change
treatment: Maintain at least two separately accountable super administrators with securely stored spare credentials and a dated recovery exercise

scenario: A diligence folder shared with outside counsel and a target company stays accessible after the deal closes or is abandoned
threat_source: Former external collaborator or their compromised account
affected_assets: Deal room Drive content, shared drives, investment memos
treatment: Give every external collaboration an owner and review date, run dated permission reviews, and prove removal at the resource rather than only disabling sharing

scenario: A user installs an AI note-taker or productivity app that requests full Drive and Gmail scope; the vendor is later breached or resells the data
affected_assets: Drive, Gmail, and Calendar content for every consenting user
treatment: Restrict high-risk OAuth scopes, require an owner and purpose for each app, investigate unknown high-access apps, and test that revoking an app ends its access

scenario: Attackers spoof the firm's domain to send a fake capital-call or wire-change notice to investors or a portfolio company while DMARC is monitoring-only
affected_assets: Firm sending domain, investor trust, counterparties' funds
treatment: Complete the sender inventory, publish validated SPF and DKIM for every sender class, and move DMARC to an approved enforcement policy after report review

scenario: A leaver is suspended but a mail delegate, an OAuth token, a shared-drive manager role, or an AppSheet app they built keeps working
threat_source: Former staff member or an orphaned automation
treatment: Run the tested leaver checklist covering identity, delegated access, third-party apps, ownership transfer, and retention before any deletion

scenario: A laptop with an active Workspace session and synced files is lost, or an unmanaged browser profile carries a malicious extension that reads Workspace pages
threat_source: Device theft, loss, or malicious browser extension
affected_assets: Cached mail and files, active sessions, saved credentials
treatment: Enforce the platform device standard, apply context-aware access where licensed, manage Chrome policies and extensions, and rehearse the lost-device response

scenario: Investor personal data or bank details are pasted into a Chat space or shared externally from Drive without anyone noticing
affected_assets: Investor personal data, finance records, regulatory standing
treatment: Where the edition supports DLP, run audit-only rules for the approved categories, review the rule log, then enable warn or block; otherwise record the gap and the manual alternative

scenario: An investigation stalls because the relevant audit events aged out of the native window or were never exported, and the alert that should have fired had no owner
affected_assets: Audit logs, email logs, incident timeline
treatment: Document each log source's window and lag, export before expiry where the approved need is longer, and test alert delivery and response

scenario: Critical shared-drive content is deleted or overwritten through a synced client and noticed only after the administrator restore window has passed
threat_source: Insider error or malware acting through a synced endpoint
affected_assets: Shared drives, finance and fund records
treatment: Agree recovery objectives per workload, select tooling that meets them, and measure a restore including permissions on a schedule

scenario: Records needed for a regulatory or legal request were purged because Vault did not cover the data type or a license was removed during offboarding
affected_assets: Gmail, Drive, Chat, and Gemini app records under a retention obligation
treatment: Approve the retention schedule, verify effective Vault rules and holds by data type and population, and keep licenses in place until preservation is confirmed

scenario: Gemini is enabled for everyone before the firm decides which Workspace data it may read; confidential deal terms enter AI conversations that nobody retains or reviews
affected_assets: Deal and investor data, AI conversation history
treatment: Record the Gemini access and Workspace-data decisions by population, set conversation history and Vault coverage deliberately, and treat external AI tools as OAuth app decisions
